package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "unicode/utf16"
    collapse "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/tailwind/collapse"
)
func main() {
    source, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]); if err != nil { panic(err) }
    var inputs []string
    if err := json.Unmarshal(source, &inputs); err != nil { panic(err) }
    for _, input := range inputs {
        output := collapse.AdamicNormalizeArgument(input)
        for _, unit := range utf16.Encode([]rune(output)) { fmt.Printf("%d,", unit) }
        fmt.Println()
    }
}
